本报告逐场核查146场核心基本面，使用固定基础版本、原始证据归档及独立发布的杯赛小组积分和赛事上下文。
伤停阵容不作为本轮补全门槛。来源已公开为空、不适用和真实冲突分别保留，不能补零冒充资料。
后采页面均为历史代理，不准入赛前预测；基础数据、冻结预测和原截止不改写。

## 六场空交锋的原文回放

```{python}
#| include: false
import csv, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from beidan_backend.fundamentals import analysis_record
receipts=json.loads((Path(r.raw_root)/'raw-receipts.json').read_text())
fixtures=list(csv.DictReader((Path(r.output)/'identities.csv').open()))
empty_h2h=[]
for fixture in fixtures:
 if fixture['fixture_id'] not in {f'26098:{x}' for x in (47,48,50,89,90,122)}: continue
 for source in ('titan','nowscore'):
  captured=next(p for p in receipts if p['fixture_id']==fixture['fixture_id'] and p['source']==source and '/analysis/' in p['url'])
  body=(Path(r.raw_root)/captured['path']).read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()==captured['sha256']
  js=next((p for p in receipts if p['fixture_id']==fixture['fixture_id'] and p['source']==source and '/analysisJs/' in p['url']),None)
  auxiliary=(Path(r.raw_root)/js['path']).read_bytes() if js else None
  if js: assert hashlib.sha256(auxiliary).hexdigest()==js['sha256']
  record=analysis_record(body,source=source,provider_id=fixture['provider_id'],auxiliary_raw=auxiliary)
  assert all(record[k]==fixture[k] for k in ('provider_id','home_id','away_id'))
  assert record['blocks']['v_data']==[]
  data=js if record['blocks_from_auxiliary'] else captured
  empty_h2h.append(dict(fixture_id=fixture['fixture_id'],source=source,state='SOURCE_PUBLISHED_EMPTY',rows=0,url=data['url'],sha256=data['sha256'],observed_at=data['capture_observed_at']))
assert len(empty_h2h)==12
(Path(r.output)/'empty-h2h-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(empty_h2h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
```

```{r}
empty <- as_tibble(jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(output,"empty-h2h-evidence.json")))
empty |> select(fixture_id,source,state,rows)
```

这六场的两源都明确公开空数组，归类为来源空结果，不是请求失败或解析失败；不据此断言双方历史上从未交手。

积分信息覆盖由91场增加至134场；余下12场已分别确认为国际友谊或亚运四分之一决赛。
“登记”项的补全前0表示原标准业务表没有这些字段，不表示原网页没有提供这些资料。
当前场次146个赛事标签、292份主场/中立场来源标记，以及17,407条有效历史的赛事标签均可关联到明确来源哈希。
历史中立场只保存显式标记；未标记保持未知。本场两源一致也不代表两源独立。

```{r}
context_reconciliation |> count(state)
stopifnot(sum(context_reconciliation$state=="LABEL_VARIANT")==90L,
 all(effective_context$state=="RESOLVED"),all(effective_history_context$state=="RESOLVED"))
```

90处同一原生赛事ID的显示标签差异保留为`LABEL_VARIANT`；没有将它们当作原生赛事冲突。
上述业务数据来自登记的六张上下文表，旧JSON/CSV只保留作前轮审计证据。
有效历史导出保留Titan和Nowscore各自的正文URL、SHA、精确采集时间及原值；
各元数据字段另列核对状态和选择来源。最大观察时间仅表示两源中较晚的观察，不能替代逐来源凭证。
逐来源时间直接使用原始采集凭证的ISO字符串并与标准表UTC时间核对，避免CSV默认时间格式丢失微秒。

## 未决项及适用限制

```{r}
audit |> filter(kickoff_state=="SOURCE_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED") |> select(fixture_id,home,away,kickoff_state)
audit |> filter(standings_state%in%c("NOT_APPLICABLE_FRIENDLY","NO_CURRENT_STAGE_GROUP_TABLE")) |> select(fixture_id,home,away,competition,stage,standings_state)
tables$conflicts |> count(field,sort=TRUE) |> slice_head(n=10)
historical_summary <- history |> summarise(rows=n(),competition_present=sum(!is.na(competition)),
 explicit_neutral_rows=sum(explicit_neutral%in%TRUE),neutral_unknown=sum(is.na(explicit_neutral)))
stopifnot(historical_summary$rows==17407L,historical_summary$explicit_neutral_rows==1562L,
 historical_summary$neutral_unknown==15845L,
 historical_summary$explicit_neutral_rows+historical_summary$neutral_unknown==historical_summary$rows)
historical_summary
neutral_limits <- history |> group_by(fixture_id) |> summarise(history_neutral_unknown=sum(is.na(explicit_neutral)),.groups="drop")
coverage_limits <- tables$conflicts |> filter(startsWith(field,"history:"),endsWith(field,":coverage")) |>
 count(fixture_id,name="history_source_coverage_differences")
stopifnot(sum(coverage_limits$history_source_coverage_differences)==310L,
 !any(startsWith(tables$conflicts$field,"history:") & !endsWith(tables$conflicts$field,":coverage")))
limits <- audit |> select(fixture_id,home,away,kickoff_state,h2h_state,standings_state) |>
 left_join(neutral_limits,by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one") |>
 left_join(coverage_limits,by="fixture_id",relationship="one-to-one") |>
 mutate(history_source_coverage_differences=replace_na(history_source_coverage_differences,0L)) |>
 mutate(history_score_scope="NOT_UNIVERSALLY_VERIFIED_90_MINUTES",source_availability="HISTORICAL_PROXY_NOT_ADMITTED",kickoff_resolution=if_else(kickoff_state=="SOURCE_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED","Actual kickoff unverified; retain both source values","No source clock disagreement"))
stopifnot(nrow(limits)==146L,!anyDuplicated(limits$fixture_id))
write_csv(limits,file.path(output,"fixture-limitations.csv"))
```

#135仍有计划时间03:00/03:10 UTC差异：俱乐部官方日历与独立预告的计划时间不同，实际开球尚未证实。
保留冲突和原截止，不平均、不择一填值。310条历史差异均为来源范围覆盖数差异，逐场单列；该版本核对表没有历史比分冲突条目，不把覆盖范围不同误记为整场不可用。
历史比分未普遍证明90分钟口径；女足#2官方报道明确含加时，证据单列而不改写结算。
这些限制与未知字段保留在逐场清单，不能用完整性报告宣称历史数据已获赛前准入。

## 实现与验收证据

```{r}
checks_path <- file.path(root,"results/26098-cup-standings-20261018/context-final-checks.json")
checks <- jsonlite::fromJSON(checks_path)
stopifnot(all(checks$checks$exit_status==0L),all(checks$checks$skipped==0L))
for(i in seq_len(nrow(checks$files))) stopifnot(digest::digest(file=file.path(root,checks$files$path[i]),algo="sha256")==checks$files$sha256[i])
knitr::kable(as_tibble(checks$checks),format="html",escape=TRUE)
cat(checks$review_command,"\n",checks$review_resolution,"\n")
as_tibble(checks$files) |> filter(grepl("context.*review|fundamentals_context|fundamentals_final|context_storage",path))
smoke <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(root,"results/26098-cup-standings-20261018/context-installed-smoke-v3.json"))
stopifnot(smoke$status=="PASS",normalizePath(smoke$library)==runtime$package)
tibble(package=smoke$library,dll=smoke$dll,rcpp_wrapper_identity=smoke$rcpp_wrapper_identity)
```

包实现和R边界分别由`test_cup_standings.py`、`test-cup-standings-boundary.R`、
`test_fundamentals_context.py`及`test-fundamentals-context-boundary.R`验证；
环境入口由`test-verification-environment.R`验证；NAS证据发布由`test_fundamentals_audit_bundle.py`验证。
正常安装后的完整R/Python测试、实际Rcpp封装调用、最终审查与输入快照身份以收据中的命令、日志、哈希为准。
失败尝试保留日志，不将中止或早期局部通过冒认为最终完整通过。无CI参与。
最终成品审查的命令、文件哈希、发现与处理结论记录在
[成品审查收据](../results/26098-cup-standings-20261018/context-final-artifact-review.json)。

```{r}
jsonlite::write_json(list(issue="26098",base_version=cfg$base_version,base_manifest_sha256=cfg$base_manifest_sha256,cup_version=params$cup_version,cup_manifest_sha256=cup_manifest_sha256,context_version=params$context_version,context_manifest_sha256=context_manifest_sha256,external_evidence_relative=cfg$external_evidence_relative,external_evidence_sha256=cfg$external_evidence_sha256,config_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(root,"config/26098-cup-standings-20261018.json"),algo="sha256"),raw_manifest_sha256=cfg$raw_manifest_sha256,previous_audit_manifest_sha256=cfg$previous_audit_manifest_sha256,qmd_sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(root,"quarto/26098_fundamentals_final_20261018.qmd"),algo="sha256"),availability_class="HISTORICAL_PROXY",historical_admission=FALSE,base_dataset_modified=FALSE,generated_at=format(Sys.time(),tz="UTC",usetz=TRUE)),file.path(output,"input-receipt.json"),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
```
